Choosing between AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 comes down to fit, features and price. AirPods with cameras and Visual Intelligence support are reportedly in development at Apple, but the earliest they'd arrive is 2027, so waiting could mean a very long wait.

AirPods 4 prioritises comfort and value, offering different options to suit different needs

The AirPods 4 use an open design, making them a good choice if you don't like in-ear tips. Our AirPods 4 review found the redesigned shape comfortable to wear without sacrificing everyday convenience.

The $129 model comes with the Apple H2 chip and personalised spatial audio, with up to 5 hours of listening time. However, it lacks Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode and wireless charging.

The $179 model adds effective noise cancellation that doesn't require a sealed ear canal, along with Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.

The open design will always let in more ambient sound, so noise cancellation takes a hit on planes or public transport.

AirPods Pro 3 is the most feature-packed option

AirPods Pro 3 retails for $249 on Apple's website, but Amazon frequently discounts them. Their foam ear tips deliver stronger bass and noticeably better noise cancellation. Apple says they last up to 8 hours with ANC on, compared to just 4 hours for AirPods 4 with ANC on.

These earbuds can monitor heart rate during workouts and support Apple's hearing test, hearing aid and hearing protection features. Our AirPods Pro 3 review found that their workout heart rate readings broadly matched Apple Watch data.

On the other hand, iOS 27 adds custom EQ to both models, and the AirPods Pro 3 pull ahead thanks to their heart rate sensor and new charging case.

Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?

This week, news about AirPods with Visual Intelligence surfaced in a hidden video in the macOS Tahoe 26.7 candidate release. The video appeared to show someone using camera-equipped AirPods to ask Siri to remember a book via Visual Intelligence, prompting speculation that the product might be coming soon.

However, subsequent reports poured cold water on that. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that AirPods with cameras aren't expected until at least 2027. The B790 model that appeared in the video is reportedly a modified version of AirPods Pro 3 that has been dropped from Apple's 2026 product roadmap. Apple is still working on an updated B798 version.

Which AirPods should you buy?

If price matters most and you don't need noise cancellation, go with the $129 AirPods 4. If you prefer the open fit, go with the AirPods 4 with ANC.

Beyond that, the AirPods Pro 3 remain the best value, especially when Amazon drops them to near the price of the AirPods 4 with ANC. They offer stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, heart rate monitoring and Apple's hearing health features.

Today's AirPods pricing

  • AirPods 4 ($99, was $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC ($148.99, was $179)
  • AirPods Pro 3 ($189.99, was $249)

Unless Visual Intelligence is a must-have for you, there's little point in waiting. Anyone who needs new earbuds now could be waiting over a year for this unannounced feature, missing out on real benefits like stronger noise cancellation and longer battery life in the meantime.

If not, just buy based on your current needs. Discounted AirPods available right now can meet most buyers' practical needs, and future camera-equipped models will likely cost more and launch at close to full price.
